title: Spicy Korean Tofu Noodle Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory stir fry made with Korean-style tofu and noodles, perfect for a quick and easy gluten-free meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tsp of sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Korean chili flakes and cook for an additional minute.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Korean noodles and cook according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and brown sugar.
Pour the soy sauce mixture over the noodles and tofu, and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
